submissionChecks.title: Note that before you submit your application, you will be required to confirm that you:
submissionChecks.footer: Chances of a successful application are greatly improved if you meet these requirements.

convictedCheck.label: Do not have any Firearms Controls Act related convictions
convictedCheck.description: Have you been convicted of any offence in terms of the Firearms Control Act, 2000 (Act No. 60 of 2000) and sentenced to a period of imprisonment without the option of a fine.

fitToPossess.label: Are fit to possess a firearm under the Act
fitToPossess.description: You are fit to possess a firearm in terms of the Firearms Control Act, 2000 (Act No. 60 of 2000).

mountedSafe.label: Have a SABS standards mounted safe for the firearm(s)
mountedSafe.description: You have a safe that is properly mounted to a fixed structure and which complies with the requirements of SABS standard 953- and / or 953-2.

safeCarry.label: Will carry the firearm(s) safely as prescribed in the Act
safeCarry.description: You will carry the firearm(s) as prescribed in Section 98(5)(a) of the Firearms Control Act, 2000 (Act No. 60 of 2000) and regulation 78 of the Firearms Control Regulations 2004.

interpreter.label: I am not using an interpreter for this application.

nominee.label: The application is submitted by me (not by/for a nominee or authorized person).

literate.label: I confirm that I can read and write English.

liability.label: I understand that GunCerts cannot guarantee that my application will be successful.

whatNext.label: What do you want to see next?
whatNext.subLabel: Tap here to tell using our Support page on our website (opens your web browser)
